blacklistabilityReview.evidence: POSTURE CHANGE on 2026-07-22: direct holder control is Yes because the material TON USDe jetton can be locked by its administrator. Ethereum USDe exposes owner-set minter authority and ordinary ERC-20 transfers but no holder freeze or blacklist, and a finalized Solana read at slot 434568679 returned freezeAuthority=null. On TON, verified jetton-minter.fc code for EQAIb6KmdfdDR7CN1GBqVJuP25iCnLKCvBlJ07Evuu2dzP5f gives the administrator an upgrade path and an admin-only call_to operation that can send set_status to any derived jetton wallet; the verified source explicitly describes this path as able to lock, unlock, or redeem funds. The 2026-07-22 state was pinned to master code hash a9bfedc76d60b332e8019e405505aadf4d7f870b8d3bae7abcfeb868681e6b2a and last transaction LT 91438387000020 / hash bf7da7303ee7eb1ac66741c08f6ba5146fc6fdde56206118f6801b30673f2727, with administrator EQCrj-smMj6JQCAvb-BPwlMa71IAA7pK3KNaFcVOdeYC6qS7. This TON holder-control path makes the asset-level direct posture true even though the reviewed Ethereum and Solana deployments lack an equivalent active freeze authority. Current 2026-10-01 Aptos state at ledger version 7436641924 additionally shows the USDe OFT object 0x9674429dcc02d2ed0d50fa24cb25262d349a5722b1a02502cff92e3cc85924b3 holding the transfer reference for USDe metadata 0xf37a8864fe737eb8ec2c2931047047cbaed1beed3fb0e5b7c5526dafd3b9c2e9 with freeze_fungible_store_enabled=true and blocklist_enabled=true. Its deployed ABI exposes set_primary_fungible_store_frozen and set_fungible_store_frozen; published Move source restricts these to the OApp admin, currently 0x84c7ac376914733149586b28acf837f3ef20eee7fe8e28a19e1a135ffca676b9. No Aptos materiality share or administrative signer composition is inferred; existing direct holder-control status remains true.

oracleRisk.summary: Ethena's offchain service sets mint and redemption RFQ amounts using exchange data, Pyth and RedStone validation, and retains last-look acceptance. USDe terms section 13 gives Ethena BVI discretion to calculate the exchanged asset's value. A user-signed order cannot be changed, but neither automatic balance-derived conversion nor autonomous feed failover determines the issuer's offered quote.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: Ethena's offchain service constructs price-sensitive mint and redemption quotes from exchange market data and validates them against Pyth and RedStone while managing the backing hedge book. This is a top-level pricing authority; USDe exposes no borrower-specific CDP markets requiring collateral-liquidation branch rows.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ethereum is the sole reviewed native USDe issuance route. The canonical Ethereum OFT adapter and all reviewed satellite deployments are representation machinery assessed under Bridge Risk, not native Mint Authority. Because the LayerZero/OFT routes depend on external messaging, endpoint configuration, and lock/mint or burn/mint token contracts outside issuer-native redemption alone, Pharos scores the reviewed route as external lock/mint. Current issuer documentation and pinned Tempo reads identify the USDe TIP-20 token and its separately listed OFT; the route controller and administrative semantics remain unresolved.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-6 (lead usde-ethena); Codex Tempo USDe linkage refresh
